jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.info.deple:
A used-up enchanted book. Stacks to 64.
Where it comes from: merging books, clearing enchantments, dropping a level I book, or a master tome running out of charges. Also found in chests and in wild chiseled bookshelves.
What to do with it: turn it back into a plain book at the table, or store it in a chiseled bookshelf — it still counts toward your shelf total.
Librarians: 2 scrolls buy 1 Emerald or 2 Amethyst Shards, and they repair plain books from Novice level.
Rewriting one into an enchanted book costs more (and needs a higher-level librarian) the rarer, more universal and higher-level the enchantment is — but always less than a vanilla Mending trade.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Chest Storage & Queued Inscribing
The table saves items inside itself just like a Chest — walk away anytime without losing a thing:
Close the screen, travel far away, or quit and reload the world — gear and materials stay safely inside the table.
During a timed ritual, you can click multiple enchantments on the same item to line them up in a single queue.
While inscribing is running, the target slot stays locked for safety; mining the table drops stored items cleanly.
Hands-Free Crafting
Queue several big enchantments, close the menu to go mining or farming, and come back to finished gear!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: How 'Was XX Levels' & Gates Work
Hovering an option shows 'Bookshelf Discount: -X% (Was Y Levels)' — here is what that really means:
[How 'Was Y Levels' is set]: Just like a vanilla Lv.30 table, base gate scales from ~12 up to 30 for max tier (or higher for rare treasures); upgrading existing tiers credits 85% of old progress!
[Use in Green-Orb Mode]: Your entry ticket, NOT full cost! At -40%, 'Was 30' becomes Lv.18 to click — you only spend 1–3 levels and keep XP bar %! This also stops low-level free-XP loops.
[Use in Purple-Flask Mode]: Without a Master Tome, the discounted level is actually paid in full — which is why storing a Tome saves tons of XP!
Quick Takeaway
No Tome = pay the full discounted levels (Purple). Stored Tome = just meet the discounted gate and spend 1–3 levels (Green)!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Классификация книжных полок
'Bookshelves' fall into clear categories — here is how every type counts across the mod:

[total nearby bookshelves = All 3 Combined]: Includes (1) Regular Bookshelves, (2) Empty Chiseled Bookshelves, and (3) Book-Holding Chiseled Bookshelves (including plain books, grimoires, Enchanted Books, AND Depleted Tomes).
[Book-Holding Chiseled Shelves]: A Chiseled Bookshelf holding plain Books or Depleted Tomes counts as a Broad Bookshelf (not a Master Tome); ONLY Enchanted Books also act as Master Tomes!

3) Wooden Bookshelf: your main progression block! Controls max tier without a Template Book, Wooden XP discount (up to -%s%%), and Treasure Epiphany — while also counting toward total shelves (%s / %s recharge speedups).
Depleted Tomes Keep Your Shelf Tier
If a Master Tome degrades into a Depleted Tome, that Chiseled Bookshelf remains an occupied Broad Bookshelf — your 38/42 healing tier never drops!

[Chests & Wild Chiseled Shelves]: Found in dungeon, temple, mansion, ancient city & stronghold library chests (10%–55%), plus weathered wild Chiseled Bookshelves (total book replacement strictly <=30%, ~17.8% avg).
